title: Plea In Supreme Court Seeks Separate Legal Identity, Protection For Intersex Persons
description: The Supreme Court today issued notice to the Union on a public interest litigation seeking separate legal identity and protective safeguards for persons born with congenital variations in sex characteristics (intersex persons). A bench of CJI Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V Mohana passed the order, after hearing petitioner-in-person Shamshravish Rein.
